title: VodafoneThree starts rollout of Ericsson AI-ready Massive MIMO radio in London
summary: VodafoneThree has become the first mobile operator globally to deploy Ericsson’s next-generation AIR 3266 Massive MIMO radio in a commercial network The lightweight, ultra-slim radio improves 5G capacity and coverage while simplifying installation and deployment Powered by next-generation Ericsson Silicon, AIR 3266 introduces dedicated neural accelerators for increased AI inference capability, while delivering 30 percent energy savings and 50 percent lower embodied carbon
body_markdown:
- VodafoneThree has become the first mobile operator globally to deploy Ericsson’s next-generation AIR 3266 Massive MIMO radio in a commercial network
- The lightweight, ultra-slim radio improves 5G capacity and coverage while simplifying installation and deployment
- Powered by next-generation Ericsson Silicon, AIR 3266 introduces dedicated neural accelerators for increased AI inference capability, while delivering 30 percent energy savings and 50 percent lower embodied carbon
